structured.answer: I didn't choose anything. I'll go over it with my son or the bank. The only track I understood was "אג"ח ממשלתי" (at מיטב: 4.9% for 3 years and 2.69% for 5 years), and I don't understand why the five-year number is lower. All the rest is shares and English letters.

stuck.why: Lots of buttons, some in English (s&p 500), and I didn't know which one was the 'safe' one. I only recognised 'אג"ח ממשלתי'.

stuck.where: The table, the 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת' column
stuck.why: Two numbers per track, '3 שנים' and '5 שנים', and the five-year one is much lower. I didn't understand which one counts.
Numbers above 100% (101%, 103%). It made no sense to me.
I got tired. Lots of rows that look alike, and I lost track of which company I was in.
